hash_semantics.source_file_sha256: SHA-256 of the upstream source file bytes inside the published sdist; the algorithm reads this file through the patch workflow
hash_semantics.patched_file_sha256_delivered: SHA-256 of the delivered patched file bytes in evidence/
hash_semantics.patched_file_sha256_logical: SHA-256 after CRLF->LF normalisation, for comparison with the enumeration record
hash_semantics.task_bundle_sha256: digest over relative path + NUL + file SHA-256 for each file in the bundle
hash_semantics.legacy: v2 hashes are preserved verbatim in v2_legacy and are not overwritten
